pages.title: Basic Character Control
pages.body:
**Character Movement**
* Your character moves using mouse point-and-click or using WASD keyboard controls
* Hold shift to switch from running to walking
* Press middle-mouse button to toggle auto-run

**Vehicle Control**
* Vehicles are driven using keyboard controls
* Mouse-controller driving can be enabled in the game settings

**Interacting With Objects**
* To interact with an object, left-click on it
* To pick up an object, right-click on it
* Right-click or shift + right-click to rotate object
* Hold alt for more control while placing or rotating the object

**Pausing the Game**
* To toggle the game pause, press spacebar or click the pause icon.

**If you get stuck**
* If you are in a vehicle, call the Tow Truck from your Contacts app of your [BizPhone](general-bizphone)
* If you are on foot, click Esc > Options > Others > Unstuck

pages.title: Energy
pages.body:
**Energy** is one of the main properties of your character.

In order to improve the energy status, you have to sleep or drink caffeine-containing drinks.

When energy reaches 0% it will have the following impact:
* Walking slower
* Risk of passing out from exhaustion
* Faster decrease of the hunger status

You can sleep on the following:
* [Bed (Double Iron)](furniture-beddoubleiron)
* [Bed (Double Iron Canopy)](furniture-beddoubleironcanopy)
* [Bed (Double Modern Canopy)](furniture-beddoublemoderncanopy)
* [Bed (Double Wooden)](furniture-beddoublewooden)
* [Bed (Full Size)](furniture-fullsizebedmodern)
* [Bed (Individual Iron)](furniture-bedindividualiron)
* [Bed (Individual Modern)](furniture-bedindividualmodern)
* [Bed (Individual Standard)](furniture-bed1)
* [Bed (Individual Wooden)](furniture-bedindividualwooden)
* [Bed (King Size)](furniture-kingsizebed)
* City Benches
* Vehicles 
* Boats

pages.title: Hunger
pages.body:
**Hunger** is one of the main properties of your character.

In order to improve the hunger status, you have to eat or drink. Consumables can be purchased in businesses around the city, or by stocking a fridge in your apartment or business.

When hunger reaches 0% it will have the following impact:
* Increased energy consumption by 200%

pages.title: Happiness
pages.body:
**Happiness** impacts your character's mood and maximum energy level. Low happiness reduces your maximum energy.

Your character's current happiness depends on which boosts are currently active. Each boost has its own duration, usually based on how long you've done that activity (up to a maximum limit per boost).

Positive boosts can be obtained by:
* Having positive revenue
* Completing personal goals
* Achieving important goals (such as opening a headquarters, hiring your first employee...)
* Walking in either park
* Walking in the cemetery
* Visiting the beach
* Swimming
* Donating to street performers
* Taking care of your hygiene
* [Watching TV](common_watchtv)
* [Playing Computer Games](common_playcomputer)
* [Reading Books](common_readbooks)
* Using a [DJ Booth](furniture-djbooth) in your home
* [Exercising](common_exercise)
* [Gambling (only on Friday evenings)](address: 5 pier)
* [Playing Golf](address:1 tur)
* [Playing Tennis](address:2 tur)
* Relaxing on your boat

Negative boosts can be obtained by:
* Sleeping in the car
* Sleeping on a bench
* Standing in the rain without an umbrella
* Not having an apartment
* Going to the hospital

pages.title: Personal Goals
pages.body:
**Personal Goals** are your character's side objectives. They are not related to the objectives given by Uncle Fred.

Achieving a personal goal gives a temporary **happiness** boost.

Personal Goals are directly connected to Steam achievements.

pages.title: BizPhone
pages.body:
Your **BizPhone** allows you to quickly conduct business from wherever you are.

BizPhone Apps:

* **Persona** - check on your personal stats and goals.
* **Contacts** - call companies you've interacted with before, like the bank or recruiters!
* [**Rivals**](rivals-overview) - Monitor how well your rivals are doing and track any attacks/rivalries against you
* [**MyEmployees**](skill-myemployees) - Manage employee recruits, company assignments, training, and satisfaction
* **BizMan** - Manage your business' schedules, uniforms, pricing and marketing
* [**Econoview**](finance-econoview) - view your Loans, Investments, Last Transactions and Income Statements
* **Voogle Maps** - get an overview of the city and use Map Filters to highlight locations and set waypoints
* **MarketInsider** - get an inside look at competition, demand, import price index, and market events

pages.title: Character Accessories
pages.body:
**Character Accessories**

Your character can hold items such as umbrellas, smartphones or headphones in your inventory.

To add an item to your inventory, click the Equip button while holding that item.

To interact with your inventory items
* Click the button near the lower corner of your character profile image to toggle your inventory
* Click the Eye icon to toggle the visibility of each item
* Click the item to unequip the item.

Accessories:
* [Umbrella](products-umbrella)
* [Noize Boss Earbuds](products-earbuds01)
* [Rhythm By Tre](products-headphones01)
* [Arty Fish Phone](products-smartphone1)
* [ZanaMan Phone](products-smartphone2)

pages.title: Manhattan Business School
pages.body:
In order to expand your business empire, you'll need to take some courses at the [Manhattan Business School](address: 7 4a).

You must complete the courses in order:

* **Basic HR** - Recruit employees from [Anderson Recruitment Corp.](address: 16 5a) or [City Workforce Inc.](address: 41 4a)
* **Market Demands** - Open and run multiple retail businesses
* **Headquarters** - Open and manage your [Headquarters](businesstypes-headquarters) to import retail goods and manage HQ personnel
* **Office Businesses** - Open and run office businesses like [Event Planning Agency](businesstypes-eventplanningagency), [Graphic Designers](businesstypes-graphicdesigner), [Law Firms](businesstypes-lawfirm), [Travel Agency](businesstypes-travelagency), and [Web Development Agencies](businesstypes-webdevelopmentagency)
* **Product Manufacturing** - Open and run [Factories](businesstypes-factory) to manufacture your own products

pages.title: Activity Rules
pages.body:
**Brick Breaker**

Use the [Scorpio Gaming Setup](furniture-scorpiogamingsetup) or any [Computer](furniture-computergroup) at home to play Brick Breaker.

Use your mouse to control your platform and bounce the ball back toward the bricks to break them all. Grab powerups to increase your score! If you miss the ball too many times, you lose.

**Golf Driving Range**

Visit [Halcyon Fairway](address:1 tur) to play golf. *Note: You must own a Hamptons home to play.*

Aim with your mouse at the various targets, then click and hold until you reach the desired distance. Targets farther away are worth more points.

**Tennis Match**

Visit [A Racket Of Love](address:2 tur) to play tennis. *Note: You must own a Hamptons home to play.*

You and your opponent take turns serving each game. Aim with your mouse and click to serve, then use keyboard controls to move your character and hit the ball back to your opponent's side!
* **Win a game:** Score points: 15, 30, 40. The next point after 40 wins, unless you are tied 40-40 - then you must win two points in a row.
* **Win a set:** Win at least 6 games and be at least 2 games ahead of your opponent.
* **Win a match:** Win 2 sets before your opponent does!

**Casino Games**

Visit [Party Pier 5](address:5 pier) on Friday nights between 18:00 and 22:00 to buy a ticket for the Casino boat.
* **Slot Machines:** place a bet and spin the reels. 3 matching symbols will award a payout!
* **Roulette:** place a bet, select Red or Black, and select a number from 1-36, or Any. If the ball lands on your selections, you win!
* **Blackjack:** place a bet and try to get as close to 21 as possible without going over. Beat the dealer's hand to win. A Blackjack (Ace + 10 or face card) is the best hand. Aces are worth 11, but become 1 if needed to avoid going over 21. Choose Surrender to give up immediately, and reclaim half your bet. Hit to draw another card, Stand to keep your current hand. If the dealer shows an Ace, you may also purchase Insurance, which pays out if the dealer has Blackjack.

pages.title: EconoView App
pages.body:
The *EconoView App* shows you all your financial information.

 **Latest Transactions**

This section will show you your recent transations. Click "Full Transactions View" to search or export your most recent transactions.

**Loans / Investments / Taxes**

This section allows you to manage your [Loans and Investments](finance-banks) and [Taxes](finance-taxes).

**Income Statement**

This section shows your income and expenses breakdown of the last several days. If you click on a business name, you can see the specific income breakdown for that business.

Note: the income statement shows you how profitable your business is, including the cost of the inventory. But since you previously paid for that inventory, that amount is not actually deducted again from your income, it is only used to show the overall profitability.

pages.title: Loans / Investments
pages.body:
**Banks** can offer you loans or investment opportunities. Manage your loans and investments in the [Econoview](finance-econoview) app on your [BizPhone](general-bizphone)

**Loans**

The banks may be willing to loan you money if you are earning a steady income and aren't already borrowing too much from that bank.

In addition to paying back the loan, you will also be charged a daily interest fee, based on the size of the loan.

**Investments**

 Each investment option has a range of possible earnings that it fluctuates between each day.
* Low Risk investments will almost always earn money, but they will earn very slowly.
* High Risk investments can potentially earn money faster, but they also have a risk of losing money.

Visit or call either bank:
* [Jensen Capital](address: 17 4a)
* [Vantander Bank](address: 6 2a)

pages.title: IRS / Taxes
pages.body:
The **IRS** charges annual taxes based on the income you've earned, minus any tax-deductible expenses.

**Taxes**

Check how much you owe in the [Econoview](finance-econoview) app on your [BizPhone](general-bizphone)

Taxes are due at the end of each year (60 days, by default), as long as you've earned enough money that year. You will receive a text message from the IRS when your taxes are ready and you will have 20 days to pay them.

**Tax Deductible Items**

Business costs will be deducted from your taxes at the end of the year.

This includes:
* Retail Appliance Stores & Office Supply Stores
* Interior Installation & Movers Fees
* Wages, Insurance, Rent, Marketing, & Recruitment
* Cost of Inventory
* Business Classes
* Delivery Vehicles & Transportation Costs
* Factory Supply Depot

**Late Fees & Back Taxes**

If you fail to pay your taxes on time, a 10% late fee will be added. You will be given 10 additional days to pay your late taxes.

If you still fail to pay your late taxes in time, they become back taxes. The IRS will begin seizing all of your vehicles daily until your back taxes are paid. You can pay off any remaining back taxes at the IRS.

**IRS**

Your taxes and back taxes can be paid by going to the following location:
* [IRS](address: 70 5a)

pages.title: Marketing / Traffic
pages.body:
When you combine your building's **Traffic Index** with any **Marketing** you have added, you get your overall **Promotion** score for your business.

You want to reach 100% promotion to maximize your potential customers.

**Traffic Index**

The traffic Index cannot be altered, so it's important to rent buildings with a high traffic index for your businesses.

Using your [BizPhone](general-bizphone) apps, you can see the building's Traffic Index in BizMan and Voogle Maps

**Marketing**

Marketing can be used to supplement your Traffic Index to increase your Promotion.

 Different building sizes will require different amounts of marketing, so you'll need to find the right combination of marketing for each business.

Marketing is more effective in areas with more Working Class citizens, such as Industry City, Lower Manhattan and Garment District. You will need more marketing in higher-end areas like Midtown.

You can get marketing campaigns from the following locations:
* [McCain's eMarketing](address:17 3a)
* [CityAds](address:5 2a)

pages.title: Customer Capacity
pages.body:
Each building has a maximum **Customer Capacity** building limit, this is the maximum number of customers you can get per hour.
* Depending on the [Building Type](building-types), the Customer Capacity can range from small 4 capacity offices to large 200 capacity theaters.

However, each furniture item only adds its own Customer Capacity. So in order to reach the Building Limit, you might need multiple of the same furniture item.
* For instance, if a piece of furniture has a customer capacity of 10, and your building limit is 30, you will need 3 of that furniture item to reach the building limit.

Keep in mind, if any furniture item's capacity is below the building's maximum capacity, it will limit the entire store's maximum Customer Capacity.

pages.title: Customer Satisfaction
pages.body:
Customers will begin to make demands about your stores. If you don't want to risk losing customers, make sure you pay attention to what they are saying.

You can monitor **Customer Satisfaction** in the BizMan App on the Insights page of your [BizPhone](general-bizphone). Keep in mind that it might take a few days for the customers to adjust to your changes.

**Customer Service**:
This is a measurement of how well your employees are taking care of the customers. Employees with higher skill and satisfaction provide a better experience for the customer.

Use your [MyEmployees App](skill-myemployees) to train your employees and see their demands.

**Pricing:**
If you alter your prices, you can monitor the customers' reaction here.

The highest acceptable price depends on which district you're in, the current lowest price in the district, and your employee's skill and satisfaction levels.

**Interior:**
* **Interior Design**: Customers like a store with nice wall and floor designs. Use the [Interior Design](building-interiordesigner) mode in your store to improve it
* **Music**: Customers enjoy listening to music while they shop. There are several [Music Options](furniture-musicgroup) for you to play music
* **Trash**: If the customers have garbage they need somewhere to throw it away! Place a [Trash Bin](furniture-trashbin) in your store to solve this problem.
* **Seating**: If customers have food to eat, they'll want a place to sit down. Place enough [Restaurant Booth](furniture-restaurantbooth) or [Dining Table](furniture-diningtablegroup) to provide them seating.
* **Uniforms**: Set employee uniforms in each business in the Settings page of your BizMan app on your [BizPhone](general-bizphone)
* **Bathrooms** Add toilets and sinks to each business to satisfy any [Bathroom](furniture-bathrooms) needs.

**Cleanliness:**
The more customers and employees you have moving around the store, the dirtier it will get.

Use a [Cleaning Station](furniture-cleaningstation) to clean or assign a cleaning employee.

pages.title: Customers Over Time
pages.body:
The **Customers Over Time** graph tracks how many customers have come into your store over a certain period of time.

Compare this information with the building's [Customer Capacity](building-limit), and it can be used to help determine the best time to be open, whether you should close on certain days of the week, or whether you need more marketing!

This graph has two modes, click the buttons at the top-right corner of the graph to switch between them:
* **Yesterday** - gives you an hour-by-hour breakdown of yesterday's customers
* **7 Days** - gives you a day-by-day overview of the last 7 days' customers

**Note:** Keep in mind, just because customers come to the store doesn't mean they are buying things. Your prices might be too high, or you might not have what they are looking for available.

pages.title: Interior Designer
pages.body:
While inside your building, click the **Interior Designer** button to enter Interior Design mode.

This gives you access to a series of tools to manage your building.

**Unpacking**
Unload and manage shelf inventory. Click on any storage shelf, display shelf, delivery pallet, or vehicle to access and manage its inventory.

**Hand / Move**
Move and rotate items in your building. Click on any object to move it around. Hold alt for more control while placing or rotating the object

**Eyedropper**
Copy and paste custom colors from one item to another. After selecting the tool, click on an item to copy the colors of that item. Click on other items to paste those colors.

To copy a new color, click on the tool again, or press ESC to reset the tool. You can also use this tool to copy a wall or floor design.

**Color Palette**
Manually set the color of any item. Click on any item in your building to recolor it.

**Undo & Redo**
Undo or redo any action in the Interior Designer mode. This will also refund design purchases or undo any items sold with the Interior Designer.

*Note:* When you close Interior Designer mode, all changes are locked and you can no longer undo / redo.

**Sell**
Sell items in your building. Click on any item to sell it.

*Note:* Everything attached to the item will also be sold. Example: If you sell a desk, it will sell the computer, chair and everything on the desk

**Floors & Walls**
Alter the designs of the floors and walls. Choose a floor or wall style, then click and drag the mouse to "paint" that design where you want it. Hold shift and click to quickly fill an entire wall or floor section!

Changing the wall and floor designs costs money, and impacts the "Interior" score of the building.

**Customer Queue**
Customize your customer queues for things like Points of Sales or Coat Checks. Click on the register to see the queue anchor points.

You can add or move anchor points to make the queue follow a more complicated path around your building. Right-click on any anchor point to delete that point.

**Security Cameras**
Quickly identify any items that aren't covered by the security camera, so you can adjust the cameras for full coverage to improve your building's [security](building-security).

**Product Selector**
Easily access and adjust the dropdown menus to select which products should be sold in your store's display cases.

**Time of Day**
Preview your building at different times of the day. By dragging the slider left or right, you can preview what your building's decorations will look like at different times of the day.

**Save Blueprint**
Once you are done decorating your store, you can save a [blueprint](building-blueprints) of the building you're currently in. Click this button, give the blueprint a name and save it!

pages.title: Blueprints
pages.body:
**Blueprints** can be found in the Esc Menu or Main Menu.

**Blueprint Creator**

From the main menu, you can create blueprints directly.

The tools are similar to the [Interior Designer](building-interiordesigner) tools, with a couple of additions.

*Furniture Tool*
Access all the furniture from the game and place it directly into your blueprint.

Hold shift to place more than one item in a row.

*Duplicate Tool*
The duplicate tool can be used to copy items you have already placed down including complete workstations with all the attachments.

Note: You can also duplicate the desk without all the attachments by holding shift while you click on the desk.

**My Library**

When you save a blueprint, it goes to the My Library tab. This is where you can manage/delete your local blueprints as well as any blueprints you have downloaded from the community.

If you would like to share your blueprints with the Big Ambitions community, you can upload your blueprints to the Steam Gallery.

**Steam Gallery**

From here you can browse and download blueprints from other community members to your own Library. You will need to create or download a blueprint before using an [Installation Firm](building-interiorinstallationfirms) to install it in your own business.

 *Note:* Each blueprint can only work in buildings of the exact same layout and size, so an A1 blueprint cannot be used in an A2 building.

pages.title: Installation Firms
pages.body:
**Installation Firms** are used to setup and install layouts into your buildings. You can use their default layouts, or a [Blueprint](building-blueprints) from your library.

After agreeing to their services for a significant base fee, plus the cost of each item, the installation will be set up for the day you select.

On that day, the business will be inaccessible until the installation is complete. Any items in the building will be sold and the price will be deducted from the total, or refunded to you if the total exceeds the amount you owe.

* [Kingdom Office](address: 43 4a) installs blueprints into your office buildings
* [Kristian Bahood](address: 2 1a) installs blueprints into your retail, cinema, and theater buildings
* [Nugem Interiors](address: 11 1a) installs blueprints into your residential buildings
* [Stonegood Architecture](address: 5 26s) installs blueprints into your warehouse buildings

Visit the agent at the installation firm to schedule your interior installation.

pages.title: Moving Services
pages.body:
**Manhattan Movers** can move any residential, retail, office, warehouse or factory to another similar size or larger location!

After agreeing to their services for a base fee, plus a fee-per-item being moved, the move will be set up for the day you select.

On that day, both businesses will be inaccessible until the move is complete. Any items in the destination building will be sold and the price will be deducted from the total, or refunded to you if the total exceeds the amount you owe.

 Visit the agent at [Manhattan Movers](address: 15 12s) office to set up your move.

pages.title: Security / Theft
pages.body:
**Security and Theft** impact your retail stores.

Unfortunately, if you leave your retail stores unguarded, you will start to lose some inventory each day - especially for your jewelry stores, which can be quite devastating!

Check the BizMan app on your [BizPhone](general-bizphone) to see your current security level. Fortunately, you can raise that score using these security features:

**Security Panels**

[Security Panels](furniture-securitypanel) can be placed on either side of the front doors.

A pair of panels will be enough to protect smaller stores with lower value inventory.

**Cameras**

Wall-Mounted [Security Cameras](furniture-securitycamera) and Ceiling-Mounted [Security Cameras (Dome)](furniture-securitycameraroof) can be placed around your store to secure items within their visibility range. Items in the view of cameras have a very low chance of being stolen, even if the building is less than 100% secure.

Larger stores with more valuable inventory may need a combination of Cameras and Security Panels.

**Security Guards**

Place a [Security Guard Locker](furniture-securityguardlocker) somewhere in your store to assign a [Security Guard](skill-securityguard) to your store's schedule.

For stores with the most valuable inventory, you'll need two fully-trained Security Guards to keep your valuables completely protected. This impacts products from stores such as:
* [Jewelry Stores](businesstypes-jewelrystore)
* [Electronics Stores](businesstypes-electronicsstore)
* [Clothing Stores](businesstypes-clothingstore)

pages.title: Bookstore
pages.body:
**Bookstore** businesses operate out of retail buildings.

All of this store's items can be ordered from [Importers](importers-contract) in your [Headquarters](businesstypes-headquarters).

Customers are self-serving.

The business requires the following furniture to function:

* [Stack of Shopping Baskets](furniture-stackofshoppingbaskets)
* [Point of Sales](furniture-itemgrouppointofsale)
* At least one product to sell (see below)

Businesses of this type primarily sell:

* [Limited Edition Book](products-limitededitionbook)
* [Motivational Book](products-motivationalbook)
* [Novel](products-novel)
* [Picture Book](products-picturebook)
* [Technical Manual](products-technicalmanual)
* [Youth Novel](products-youngnovel)

And can additionally sell:

* [Gifts (Cheap)](products-cheapgift)
* [Flower (Cheap)](products-cheapflower)
* [Noize Boss Earbuds](products-earbuds01)
* [Umbrella](products-umbrella)

Employees with the following skills can be assigned:

* [Customer Service](skill-customerservice)
* [Cleaning](skill-cleaning)

pages.title: Coffee Shop
pages.body:
**Coffee Shop** businesses operate out of retail buildings.

All of this store's items can be ordered from [Wholesalers](wholesalers-locations).

Customers are served by employees.

The business requires the following furniture to function:

* [Cash Register](furniture-cashregister)
* At least one product to sell (see below)

Businesses of this type primarily sell:

* [Croissant](products-croissant)
* [Cup of Coffee](products-cupofcoffee)
* [Cup of Tea](products-cupoftea)
* [Cupcake](products-cupcake)

pages.title: Actor
pages.body:
Employees with the **Actor** skill are used for theaters.

Actors perform on stage for the paying customers.

The skill level (%) defines how satisfied the customers will be.

They can be assigned to:
* [Dressing Room](furniture-dressingroom)

They can be hired from:
* [C.A.S.T.](address: 5 bw)

pages.title: Cleaning
pages.body:
Employees with the **Cleaning** skill are used for retail businesses.

Cleaning employees each clean your store or office during the hours they are scheduled.
They can be scheduled any time during the day, even before opening hours or after closing hours.
They cannot be scheduled for any day that the store is not open.

The skill level (%) defines how much they can clean each hour.
Smaller stores will typically only require a few hours of cleaning per day.
Stores with a high customer volume will require more.

They can be assigned to:
* [Cleaning Stations](furniture-cleaningstation)

They can be hired from:
* [Anderson Recruitment Corp.](address: 16 5a)

pages.title: Customer Service
pages.body:
Employees with the **Customer Service** skill are used for retail businesses.

Customer Service employees each work at any retail location's point of sale to serve customers.
They will also refill display inventory from storage shelves in the back

The skill level (%) defines how well the customers will be treated.

They can be assigned to:
* [Points of Sales](furniture-itemgrouppointofsale)
* [Coat Check (Left)](furniture-coatcheckleft)
* [Coat Check (Right)](furniture-coatcheckright)

They can be hired from:
* [Anderson Recruitment Corp.](address: 16 5a)

pages.title: Delivery Driver
pages.body:
Employees with the **Delivery Driver** skill are used for Warehouses and Factories.

Delivery Drivers each are assigned to a vehicle in the warehouse or factory and will deliver goods to your stores at 02:00 (2:00 AM) based on the Logistics Manager's delivery setup.
Note: You don't see the drivers making deliveries.

The skill level (%) defines which types of vehicles they can drive.
* [Freight Truck T1](vehicles-freighttruckt1) requires 95% skill
* [Vord Courier D500](vehicles-deliverytruck) requires 75% skill
* [Mersaidi Dash](vehicles-mersaididash) requires 50% skill
* [UMC Nunavet](vehicles-umcnunavut) requires 50% skill
* [Vord V150](vehicles-vordv150) requires 50% skill

They can be assigned to:
* [Warehouse](businesstypes-warehouse)
* [Factory](businesstypes-factory)

They can be hired from:
* [Anderson Recruitment Corp.](address: 16 5a)

pages.title: DJ

DJs play music and keep the customers dancing and spending more money.

pages.title: Headhunter
pages.body:
Employees with the **Headhunter** skill are used for headquarters.

Similiar to the Recruitment Offices, headhunters can recruit employees, with more filter options based on their skill level. You can set a target number of candidates to recruit, or let them recruit until you stop them.

You can manage your recruits on the [MyEmployees App](skill-myemployees) on your [BizPhone](general-bizphone)

Additionally, you can connect Headhunters with HR Managers, and for every employee assigned to that HR Manager, the Headhunter will provide a automatic replacement worker when they are poached (within 3-5 days), resign (within 1 day), or retire (instantly). 

The skill level (%) defines how quickly they recruit, how many HR Managers they can supervise and how closely the replacement employees match the employee they are replacing.

They can be assigned to:
* [Computer Workstation](furniture-computerworkstation)

They can be hired from:
* [City Workforce Inc.](address: 41 4a)

pages.title: HR Manager
pages.body:
Employees with the **HR Manager** skill are used for headquarters.

For every employee assigned to the HR Manager, HR will:
* Increase the employee's skill while they work
* Provide a temporary worker to cover the employee's shift if they get sick.
* Manage a [Health Insurance Plan](employees-demands-healthinsurance) from the [Hospital](address: 2 7s) for the employee

The skill level (%) defines how many employees they can handle and how much automatic employee training costs.

They can be assigned to:
* [Computer Workstation](furniture-computerworkstation)

They can be hired from:
* [City Workforce Inc.](address: 41 4a)

pages.title: Pricing Manager
pages.body:
Employees with the **Pricing Manager** skill are used for headquarters.

Each Pricing Manager can manage prices for every item sold in one neighborhood.

To manage multiple neighborhoods, you will need multiple Pricing Managers, as prices will reset if you unassign the employee.

Pricing Managers will also give you updates each morning with their suggested prices for each item, as well as any rival's current price.

The skill level (%) defines the accuracy of their daily pricing suggestions.

They can be assigned to:
* [Computer Workstation](furniture-computerworkstation)

pages.title: MyEmployees App
pages.body:
The *MyEmployees App* lets you manage your employees and recruits.

**Employees**

You can manage all of your hired employees in this menu. From here you can see their current age, wage, skill levels, satisfaction, business assignment, demands, uniforms and more.

**Candidates**

You can manage any new recruits in this tab.

You can assign them to a business, hire them, or reject potential employees. If you don't take action before the offer expires, they will automatically be deleted from the list. 

Recruits can come from the following sources:

* [Job Board](furniture-jobboard)
* [Anderson Recruitment Corp.](address: 16 5a)
* [City Workforce Inc.](address: 41 4a)
* [C.A.S.T.](address: 5 bw)
* [Headhunter](skill-headhunter) Employee

**Employee Actions**

Select an employee to get more details about that employee.

From there, you can pay the employee a bonus, assign uniforms, assign current business, or send the employee to training.

**Mass Employee Actions**

You can select multiple Employees or Candidates by clicking on the checkmark next to their name. Shift-click to select multiple employees in a row.

Once your employees are selected, you can use the drop-down menu up top to apply an action to all the selected employees.

pages.title: Employee Skill / Training
pages.body:
Your employee's *skill level* impacts their job performance and customer service.

**Training**

Employee skill can be increased through training.

* **Manual training** - train the employee from the [MyEmployees](skill-myemployees) app on your [BizPhone](general-bizphone). This increases skill the fastest, but requires the employee be unassigned from their position during training. Training ends at 17:00 (5pm) the day after they have been sent to training.
* **Automatic HR Manager Training** - if your employee is assigned to an [HR Manager](skill-hrmanager), they will automatically increase their skill slowly each day. The employee continues to work during this training.
* **On-the-job Training** - while your employee works, they will very slowly gain skill overtime through natural on-the-job training. This is the slowest way to increase skill.

**Wages**

As your employees increase in skill, their wages will also increase.

pages.title: Demands Overview
pages.body:
Each employee will have up to 3 demands. Meeting the demands will ensure the employee is satisfied, but if you ignore the demands, the employee will eventually resign.

Demands come in three levels of urgency:
* Critical
* Important
* Nice To Have
The higher the priority of the demand, the more impact it will have on the employee's satisfaction.

There are different demands the employees can have: 
* [Employee Health Insurance](employees-demands-healthinsurance)
* [Environment Demands](employees-demands-environment)
* [Equipment Demands](employees-demands-equipment)
* [Schedule Demands](employees-demands-schedule)

pages.title: Employee Health Insurance
pages.body:
As part of their Wants and Demands, some employees will demand **Employee Health Insurance**

Employees can demand:
* Gold Health Insurance
* Silver Health Insurance, or higher
* Bronze Health Insurance, or higher

To set up Health Insurance, perform the following steps:
* Visit the Hospital and talk to the [Health Insurance Manager](address: 2 7s)
* Choose an [HR Manager](skill-hrmanager) and a level of Insurance: Gold, Silver, Bronze
* The Health Insurance Manager will soon send a text message with an offer.
* You can Accept, Reject, or Negotiate this offer.

Once you accept, the employees assigned to the HR Manager will be covered by the chosen plan.

Note: 
* HR Manager skill determines what level of insurance they can request
* You will be charged for a minimum of 10 employees
* You will be charged daily for this plan 
* Your HR Manager can upgrade their plan at any time on their BizMan app on your [BizPhone](general-bizphone)

pages.body:

pages.title: Employee Schedule
pages.body:
**Setting the Employee's Schedule**

Once you have assigned the employee to a business in the [MyEmployees](skill-myemployees) app on your [BizPhone](general-bizphone), visit the BizMan page for that business and click on the "Schedule" tab.

From there, click-and-drag the employee's name to the employee workstation below the schedule. From there, you can adjust the hours and days you want them to work.

**Schedule Demands**

As part of their Wants and Demands, some employees will demand a certain schedule.
* Part-time: Between 10 and 30 hours per week
* Full-time: Between 30 and 50 hours per week
* Four days week: Assigned to work 4 days a week
* Five days week: Assigned to work 5 days a week
* No morning shifts: No shifts assigned between 06:00 (6 AM) and 10:00 (10 AM)
* No afternoon shifts: No shifts assigned between 14:00 (2 PM) and 16:00 (4 PM)
* No evening shifts: No shifts assigned between 18:00 (6 PM) and 22:00 (10 PM)
* No night shifts: No shifts assigned between 22:00 (10 PM) and 04:00 (4 AM)
* Free Weekends: No Saturdays/Sundays shifts
* No cleaning shifts: No cleaning shifts assigned

pages.title: Shortages & Backorders
pages.body:
**Shortages and Backorders**

 An item can go on a two-week *Shortage* when:
* Too many stores are ordering that item from the same store
* A large quantity of that item was recently purchased
* The item was recently going through a Hype event

If these events happen while the item is already on a shortage, it can trigger a week-long *Backorder*.

**Impact of Shortages and Backorders**

If an item is on a *Shortage*, the price for that item will increase, but you will still be able to purchase it.

If an item is on a *Backorder*, you will not be able to purchase that item until the backorder ends.

In both cases, customer demand will increase for the duration since some rivals might not be able to sell until the shortage or backorder ends.

If you are able to continue selling through a shortage or backorder, you could make a nice boost in income!

**Shop Around**

Shortages and Backorders are specific to each Wholesaler or Importer, so if one store is on backorder, be sure to check for other options.

pages.title: Weekly Delivery Limits
pages.body:
**Weekly Delivery Limits**

Each importer and wholesaler has a weekly limit for deliveries on each item.
* Weekly limits reset Monday at 08:00 (8 AM)
*  Any Urgent Orders placed during the week also count toward the weekly limits

**Wholesalers**
* Items purchased directly at drive-in wholesale stores do not count toward the weekly limits
* Weekly limits are tracked per store you deliver to

**Importers**
* Weekly limits are tracked per Importer location
* All Purchasing Agent contracts with the same Importer share a weekly limit

pages.title: Wholesaler - Ordering Wholesale
pages.body:
**Purchasing From a Wholesaler**

Visit any [wholesale location](wholesalers-locations). to purchase inventory to be resold at your stores.

**Delivering to Your Stores**

* Speak to the manager at any wholesale store to set up a delivery contract
* Manage your weekly deliveries in the Deliveries tab of the BizMan app on your [BizPhone](general-bizphone)
* Deliveries happen Monday mornings at 08:00 (8 AM)
* Your order must be placed by Sunday night at 20:00 (8 PM)
* Each delivery location needs [Storage Shelves](furniture-storageshelf) with enough free space to receive the inventory
* You must have enough money to pay for the order

**Repeating Order**

When enabled, this will automatically reorder each week until you disable it.

**Urgent Orders**

If you need an order delivered in the middle of the week, you can request an Urgent Order.
* Your current order will arrive the next morning
* A surcharge will apply based on your difficulty level
* Urgent Orders count toward your [weekly limit](wholesalers-weeklylimits)

pages.title: Importer - Ordering Imports
pages.body:
**How to Order Imports to Your Warehouse or Factory**

After setting up your [Import contract](importers-contract), it's time to import inventory!

The MarketInsider app on your [BizPhone](general-bizphone) will show the daily import index for each product, which impacts the purchase price.

**Ensure Successful Imports**
* Imports happen Monday mornings at 08:00 (8 AM)
* Your order must be placed by Sunday night at 20:00 (8 PM)
* Import locations need [Pallet Shelves](furniture-palletshelf) to receive the inventory
* You must have enough money to pay for the order
* Imports are made to each warehouse in the order they are listed

**Repeating Order**

When *Enabled*, this will automatically reorder each week until you *Disable* it.

**Smart Delivery**

When *Disabled*, the agent orders the amount you enter.

When *Enabled*, the agent treats your number as a target and adjusts the order based on warehouse stock.
If your warehouse stock exceeds your target, nothing will be ordered.

*Smart Delivery Example:*
Your target is 500, and your warehouse currently has 300. Your Purchasing Agent will order 200.

**Urgent Orders**

If you need an order delivered in the middle of the week, you can request an Urgent Order.
* Your current order will arrive the next morning
* A surcharge will apply based on your difficulty level
* Urgent Orders count toward your [weekly limit](wholesalers-weeklylimits)

pages.title: Importer - Logistics Manager
pages.body:
**Delivery Plan**
* Hire a [Logistics Manager](skill-logisticsmanager)
* Create a [Computer Workstation](furniture-computerworkstation) for them in your [Headquarters](businesstypes-headquarters)
* Assign the Manager to the workstation and the headquarters schedule
* Create and manage their delivery plan in the BizMan app on your [BizPhone](general-bizphone)

Each Logistics Manager can manage one Delivery Plan at a time for either [Warehouses](logistics-warehouse) or [Factories](logistics-factory).

**Number of Delivery Locations Is Based On**
* Skill of the Logistics Manager
* How many vehicles/slots are in the warehouse or factory
* Type of the delivery vehicles

**Warehouse Delivery Vehicles**
* Up to 4 delivery Locations: [Mersaidi Dash](vehicles-mersaididash)
* Up to 4 delivery Locations: [UMC Nunavut](vehicles-umcnunavut)
* Up to 4 delivery Locations: [Vord V150](vehicles-vordv150)
* Up to 6 delivery Locations: [Vord Courier D500](vehicles-deliverytruck)
* Up to 8 delivery Locations: [Freight Truck T1](vehicles-freighttruckt1)

Purchase a vehicle, drive it into your [warehouse](businesstypes-warehouse) or [factory](businesstypes-factory) and assign it to a [Delivery Driver](skill-deliverydriver).

pages.title: Importer - Warehouse Deliveries
pages.body:
**How to Deliver Inventory from Warehouses**

After setting up your [Delivery Plans](logistics-contract), it's time to deliver to your stores or other warehouses!

**Ensure Successful Deliveries**
* Delivery Plans are shipped once per day at 02:00 (2 AM)
* Each retail delivery location needs [Storage Shelves](furniture-storageshelf) to receive the inventory
* Each warehouse / factory delivery location needs [Pallet Shelves](furniture-palletshelf) to receive the inventory
* Deliveries are made to each store or warehouse in the order they are listed

**Smart Deliveries**

The Logistics Manager will adjust the delivery amount based on current store stock (this includes all the inventory in the store - on storage shelves and on display shelves)

*Example:*
Your target amount is 5,000 Paperbags.
Your store already has a Cash Register holding 1,000 Paperbags
Your store also has a Storage Shelf holding 2,000 Paperbags.
Your Logistics Manager will ship 2,000 more Paperbags so your store total is 5,000.

**Export to Warehouses**

You can also ship from one warehouse to another warehouse or factory to create a more complex logistics network.

Simply set the other warehouse or factory as one of the Logistics Manager's destinations in their Delivery Plan.

pages.title: Importer - Factory Deliveries
pages.body:
**How to Deliver Inventory from Factories**

After setting up your [Delivery Plans](logistics-contract), it's time to deliver goods to your warehouses!

**Ensure Successful Deliveries**
* Delivery Plans are shipped once per day at 08:00 (8 AM)
* Each warehouse / factory delivery location needs [Pallet Shelves](furniture-palletshelf) to receive the inventory
* Deliveries are made to each warehouse in the order they are listed

**Deliver "Up To" Amount**

The Logistics Manager will attempt to fill each warehouse up to amount you enter.

If the factory runs out of that item, it will deliver as much as it can.

**Export to Pier Locations**

You can also sell goods back to the import/export piers.
* [Jet Cargo Imports](importers-jetcargo)
* [Seaside Internationals](importers-seaside)
* [United Ocean Imports](importers-unitedocean)
* [Bluestone Imports](importers-bluestone)
* [Lunar Tide Shipments](importers-lunartide)
* [Maritime Freight Line](importers-maritimefreight)
* [Aquatic Bay Cargo](importers-aquaticbay)
* [Global Harvest Traders](importers-globalharvest)

Simply set the pier location as one of the Logistics Manager's destinations in their Delivery Plan.

The MarketInsider app on your [BizPhone](general-bizphone) will show the daily import index for each product, which impacts the sale price.

pages.title: Rivals Overview
pages.body:
**The Rivalry Begins**

You may be new to the city, but it's already filled with 20 savvy business rivals who won't take too kindly to you stepping onto their turf!

You will face two types of rivals:
* [Special Rivals](special-rivals)
* [Minor Rivals](minor-rivals)

As you build up your businesses, expect the rivals to launch several different types of attacks to try to slow you down and hinder your progress. Show them that you're here to stay and declare your dominance over New York City!

**Rivals App**

Track and monitor your rivals' actions in the Rivals app on your [BizPhone](general-bizphone)

pages.title: Special Rivals
pages.body:
Each neighborhood has their own *Special Rival*:
* **Ingrid Schneider** in Garment District
* **Jessica Johnson** in Hell's Kitchen
* **Thierry Laurent Moreau** in Murray Hill
* **Huang Guo** in Midtown.

These rivals will attempt to sabotage your businesses as you grow. An active rival won't even let you rent from their buildings!

**Special Rival Attacks**
* Lowered Prices - the rival will lower their prices on some items you also sell, forcing you to lower your prices or lose customers.

* Lowered Demand - the rival will start new businesses that you are also running, in order to lower the demand of the products you are selling.

* Poaching Employees - the rival can offer your best employees an even better salary. You will have the opportunity to match that salary if you want to keep them.

pages.title: Minor Rivals
pages.body:
The minor rivals are different in each playthrough, and they are scattered throughout the 5 districts.

**Minor Rival Attacks**

These rivals won't target you as directly and intensely as the special rivals, but they can still cause pain as they can offer your employees better job conditions.

To avoid losing your employees to these rivals:
* Fulfill the employees' demands
* Train their primary skill
* Keep them assigned to a task.

And, of course, it never hurts to give your employees a bonus from the [MyEmployees](skill-myemployees) app on your [BizPhone](general-bizphone)!

pages.title: Counterattacks
pages.body:
It's time to fight back against the rivals! 

**Counterattacks**
* Lowered Prices - if you lower your selling price on items rivals also sell, all the rivals in that neighborhood will be forced to lower their prices as well, and lose some of their weekly income. And if you keep this up for a few weeks, you'll also see their stores' valuation going down!

* Lowered Demand - you can open up new businesses that your rivals are also running in order to lower the demand of the products they are selling, which will also lower their weekly income.

* Poaching Employees - you can find each rivals' employees listed in their company's BizMan page. Here you can attempt to poach a rival's employees by negotiating a better wage for them. If you successfully poach them, the rival will be forced to replace them with an inferior employee, lowering their store's weekly income.

pages.title: Alternate Travel Options
pages.body:
If you don't want to buy a car and deal with parking and traffic, there are a few options:

**Taxis** 

Taxis randomly drive through the city ready to drive you around for a fee.

When one is near you, click on it and select the building you'd like to travel to.

**Subway Stations**

Subway Stations are in various locations around the city.

When you are near a subway station, click on it, then click on another subway station to travel there for a fee.

**Electric Scooters**

Electric Scooters are found charging in various locations around the city.

For a fee, you can rent these scooters.

*Note:* You can hold a paper bag but you cannot carry boxes or use any hand trucks or flatbeds while using the electric scooter.

**Private Driver**

Hire a [private driver](vehicles-privatedriver) and drop off your vehicle at [Onyx Luxury Chauffeurs](address:10 7a)!

pages.title: Onyx Private Driver / Chauffeur
pages.body:
**Onyx Private Driver / Chauffeur**

Hire a private driver service at [Onyx Luxury Chauffeurs](address:10 7a), then drop off your vehicles in the attached garage outside.

You can choose from three levels of service, Basic Driver, Advanced Driver, or Premium Driver. This level of service determines how many vehicles your driver can maintain, and what types of vehicles they are insured to drive.

After setting up your service from Onyx Luxury Chauffeurs, click the new driver app icon at the top-left of your BizPhone to summon your private driver to take you anywhere you need to go!

**Bonus Perks**

Riding with your private driver gives you a 12-hour, 10% happiness boost

And if your premium driver picks you up in a Limo, you get an extra +5% happiness, +5% energy, and +10% hunger!

pages.title: Gas Station and Vehicle Repair
pages.body:
**Gas Station and Vehicle Repair Shops** are used to fix any issues with your vehicles and bring them back to their original condition.

**Fuel**

As you drive around, your vehicle will use fuel - you can see your current fuel levels in the vehicle panel while driving. Visit a gas station to refuel your vehicle.

**Vechicle Condition**

Each time you crash into something, your vehicle will take damage - you can see your current vehicle condition in the vehicle panel while driving. Visit the garage next to the gas station to repair your vehicle.

**Car Wash**

While driving around, your vehicle will start to get dirty. Visit the garage next to the gas station to clean your vehicle.

**Calling the Tow Truck**

If your vehicle runs out of fuel or your vehicle condition hits 0%, you can't drive the vehicle. In that case, call the Tow Truck from the Contacts app of your [BizPhone](general-bizphone)

Gas Stations can be found at the following locations:
* [Freedom Fuel](address: 14 11s)
* [Manhattan Gas](address: 47 5a)
* [Refuel and Recharge](address: 10 24s)
* [United Gasoline](address: 7 1a)
* [Beacon Point Petrol](address: 14 7a)

And a larger station for Freight Trucks can be found at the following locations:
* [IC Truckers](address: 3 7a)

requirements.note: BUSINESS.requirements reads the business page's own requirement list. Its wording is kept in raw: the help says these are needed for the business to function, but not that the list is the complete set of rules the game enforces.

GAPS.detail: None of the 37 help pages the sample reads carries a money figure, so the sample states no price for any fixture, product, recipe or business it describes. Money figures do appear in en.json, on 17 help pages this sample does not read.
help_wholesalers_weeklylimits_content says every importer and wholesaler caps each item per week and that the cap resets Monday 08:00, but never gives a number for any item.

GAPS.what: Rated rate is a ceiling, not a measurement
GAPS.detail: Every recipe page gives a 'Max Production Rate Per Hour'. The help states that ceiling and nothing more: it does not say what a line achieves in practice, nor what happens when an ingredient runs out mid-hour. Big Copilot's day model takes that hourly maximum times 24, which assumes an uninterrupted line at full utilisation; no measured output lies behind it, and help text cannot supply one.

GAPS.what: Customer capacity by size code is ambiguous
GAPS.detail: help_building_types_content lists the same size code under more than one building type: C1 is 30 customers as retail and 8 customers as office; C2 is 30 customers as retail and 8 customers as office; D2 is 40 customers as retail and 10 customers as office. A size code alone therefore does not fix a shop's door limit, and the bundled building table stores only the letter.

GAPS.what: Help links that point at no page
GAPS.detail: 36 links across 16 distinct targets name a page the help menu does not contain, the most often common_exercise (17), common_accessories (5), furniture-chair (1), furniture-desk (1), itemname_classiccheapmaleclothing (1). The renderer has to degrade those links to plain text, not throw.

GAPS.what: Malformed markdown and inconsistent names in the source
GAPS.detail: 1 help page opens a bold marker and never closes it. Supplier names are spelled more than one way for the same address: 1 pier (Jet Cargo Imports / JetCargo Imports); 1 tur (Halcyon Fairway / Haylcon Fairway / Playing Golf); 11 1a (Mr. Scott's Office Supplies / Nugem Interiors); 2 7s (Health Insurance Manager / Hospital); 3 more.

Steam's depot build id for this install is app 1331550, buildid 25231854. The shipped layouts counted for placement were authored at builds 3521, 3629. Both are install facts; the third number, the one a save carries, is not in this payload because no save was read - and neither install number stands in for it.

GAPS.what: A wholesale 'no' is an absence, not a rule
GAPS.detail: Gift (Expensive) states no wholesale purchase and is absent from the wholesaler product list, so the wholesale flag is false. That is two help pages agreeing, not a game rule: the help may simply not mention it.

GAPS.what: The sample is one business, the pages are all of them
GAPS.detail: The pages array covers every help page in the menu. The sample keeps the Gift Shop worked example the wiki page is written around: its fixtures, products, recipes and suppliers. Every other business reads its facts from pages, not from this sample.

notes.sourceDate: sourceDate is the newest file modification date among the game help and counted layouts, not the moment this payload was built. An unchanged install therefore rebuilds byte-identical output; the sample's SOURCES block repeats it as sourceDate, and keeps the older extracted key with the same value for shapes written against the mockup.
notes.determinism: Built from the game files named in sources. No run timestamp is written, so an unchanged install builds byte-identical output.
notes.privacy: Source paths are game-relative. No absolute path, user name or save data travels in this file.
notes.unparsed: 24 statements in the help could not be read into a field; they remain in the page text verbatim and are listed per record in the catalogue the extractor writes.
